description: This file defines a Perl module Git::SVN::Ra that wraps around SVN::Ra to provide customized remote access functions for git-svn. It includes methods for repository interaction, configuration, and version compatibility handling, with caching and specific svn operations implemented.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Ra
classes.description: Perl module providing a customized SVN::Ra interface for git-svn, including caching, version compatibility, and additional helpers.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new instance of Git::SVN::Ra, initializes repository connection, caching, and canonicalizes URL.

methods.name: check_path
methods.description: Checks the existence and type of a given path within the repository with caching.

methods.name: get_dir
methods.description: Retrieves directory listing with caching, optionally in SVN 1.4+ optimized mode.

methods.name: get_log
methods.description: Retrieves logs over a range, wrapping callback to normalize paths and support version-specific features.

methods.name: get_commit_editor
methods.description: Provides a commit editor, with version-specific adjustments.

methods.name: gs_do_update
methods.description: Performs an SVN update with custom handling of paths and editor.

methods.name: gs_do_switch
methods.description: Performs SVN switch, handling URL reparenting and reversion.

methods.name: longest_common_path
methods.description: Calculates the longest common prefix path among a set of paths.

methods.name: match_globs
methods.description: Matches globs and paths, expanding directories recursively if needed.

methods.name: is_ref_ignored
methods.description: Checks if a reference path matches ignore regex patterns.

methods.name: minimize_url
methods.description: Returns the shortest form of the URL relative to the repository root.

methods.name: skip_unknown_revs
methods.description: Handles specific SVN errors by ignoring known non-critical errors related to revision existence.
